request: Vault nonsecret active container revision and authenticated internal health inspection.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
n=libral-vault-libral-vault-1
info=$(docker inspect "$n" --format 'container={{.Name}} state={{.State.Status}} health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}} image={{.Image}} started={{.State.StartedAt}}')
image=$(docker inspect "$n" --format '{{.Image}}')
created=$(docker image inspect "$image" --format '{{.Created}}' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
api=$(docker exec "$n" node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f=process.env.LIBRAL_VAULT_INTERNAL_TOKEN_FILE;const t=f?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8").trim():process.env.LIBRAL_VAULT_INTERNAL_TOKEN;fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8791/internal/v1/health",{headers:{authorization:"Bearer "+t}}).then(async r=>{let j=await r.json();console.log("http="+r.status+" state="+String(j.status||j.state||"unknown")+" keys="+Object.keys(j).sort().join(","))}).catch(e=>{console.log("HEALTH_REQUEST_FAILED="+e.name);process.exitCode=1})')
body=$(printf 'VAULT_RUNTIME_DETAIL\n%s\nimage_created=%s\napi=%s\n' "$info" "$created" "$api")
printf '%s\n' "$body"
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'
